# Faceless Finesse

> Faceless Finesse is an AI-guided web app that helps beginners and existing creators pick an easy-to-rank micro-niche, generate scripts, text/image/video posts, and auto-post to YouTube, Facebook and X on a 30-day calendar. It is SaaS / AI content creation software, available online worldwide, sold through Whop with a 3-day free trial.

Faceless Finesse turns the faceless-content playbook (niche → offer → ideas → scripts → calendar → daily autopilot → monetization) into one guided flow with a single clear next step on every screen. TikTok and Instagram auto-posting are planned for later.

## Services

- [How it works](https://facelessfinesse.com/how-it-works): The guided flow from welcome screen and short quiz to niche, offer, scripts, posts, calendar, monetization map, autopilot and auto-posting.
- [Features](https://facelessfinesse.com/features): AI niche and micro-niche finder with Ease-to-Rank score, offer builder, idea and 30-second script studio, text/text-on-image/image/video posts, 30-day calendar, daily autopilot, auto-posting.
- [Start a faceless YouTube channel](https://facelessfinesse.com/guides/start-a-faceless-youtube-channel): Step-by-step guide for beginners.
- [Pick a profitable niche](https://facelessfinesse.com/guides/pick-a-profitable-niche): How to find demand, weak competition and buyer intent, then narrow to a micro-niche.
- [Auto-post to YouTube, Facebook and X](https://facelessfinesse.com/guides/auto-post-youtube-facebook-x): Connect accounts once and publish from a calendar, approve-first by default.
